_readme: Amora's own member-facing words for its tokens (the lead, 11 Nov 2026). Nothing loads this file at boot. A person applies each description in Admin, Tokens, on the token's own card (the `tokens.description` column the wallet shows under the token's name). The platform's neutral default for an equity-kind token with no description is `equityTokenNote` in shared/tokenNote.ts. No wording here promises a conversion to cash or to equity.
earned-equity: Earned Equity tracks contributions that were not paid. It has no financial value yet. What it will represent is still being decided together.
